findings.change: Optionally set CreatedCommit to the resumed commit (parent) on that recheck too.
findings.claim: When a review resumes a commit kept from an earlier round (the 'resumed commit' path), a timeout at its claim recheck says 'nothing was committed' even though that retained commit already exists in the kept worktree.
findings.evidence: internal/goal/branch/commit.go:489-491 (resumedCommit branch) returns checkClaim's error without CreatedCommit, so intent_unit_review.go's new block picks 'nothing was committed'. The brief names only the recheck after a fresh commit (:494-505), which is handled; the next act is the same command either way, so a person is not misled into a different action. Not material: no reproduction of harm, and the slice works and is safe without it (R-124-m1u).

findings.claim: The wording names 3 s for any process or transport expiry, while FreshProjection's transport cap can be shorter (the lesser of 3 s and three quarters of the remaining allowance), and a caller's own parent deadline expiring inside FreshProjection is labelled as the 4 s projection limit.
findings.evidence: internal/goal/project.go ReadTimeoutMessage defaults to defaultFreshFetchProcessTimeout; internal/goal/fresh.go:57-58 wraps whenever the derived context expired, which also happens when the caller's parent context expired first. Only the number in the message can be slightly off; the kind and next act are right. Not material.
